prompt:
Character reference sheet, one wide image in two parts, photorealistic photograph. LEFT two-thirds: full-body turnaround of the same person, three views side by side at identical scale: front view, exact 90-degree side view, exact 180-degree back view, relaxed A-pose. RIGHT third: close-up head-and-shoulders portrait of the SAME person facing camera, mouth closed. Plain light-grey background, soft even studio light at a neutral white balance, no shadows, natural skin texture with pores, no text, no labels, no watermark.
The person: 纪然, a fictional 27-year-old, Heroine; owner of Jiejian Company, daughter of Ji Hongyuan, and ex-girlfriend of Lu Shaoze; the face, skin and build of exactly that age, which the role does not change. Appearance: Strikingly beautiful East Asian woman in her late twenties who looks young and fresh. Small, delicate oval face with high cheekbones, a fine straight nose, a softly pointed chin and refined, elegant bone structure. Bright, intelligent, self-possessed almond eyes. Flawless, luminous, even fair complexion with no redness and natural skin texture. Full glamorous make-up: defined brows, long lashes, a glossy rose-nude lip. Long, glossy black hair falls past her shoulders in smooth, polished waves with a side part. About 174 cm tall with a small head and long legs, about eight heads tall, with elegant supermodel proportions. Curvy figure with full hips, a defined waist and an hourglass shape, and a full C-to-D-cup bust. Fashion-editorial poise. She wears small diamond stud earrings and a slim gold watch.. Wearing one outfit only: Office, day one: a fitted dove-grey silk shirt with the top buttons open to a modest V, tucked into a black high-waisted bodycon pencil skirt that cinches the waist and ends just above the knee. Red pointed-toe stiletto pumps. Diamond studs and a slim gold watch.. Signature colour: red. Expression in the close-up shows: Cool, sharp-tongued and fiercely independent. She is scarred by a father who treats her as a bargaining chip and by the first love he drove away. She is determined to choose her own man on her own efficient terms. Underneath she has a dry sense of humour and a soft heart she guards closely.. The full-body views keep the body's build and proportions as the appearance gives them, head-to-body ratio included, never slimmer. Cast as a commercial live-action short drama: an adult lead (the heroine, the hero) or a young adult woman in a prominent role is a strikingly beautiful or handsome, camera-ready actor, with the figure, make-up, hair and fitted outfit the appearance and outfit give; a character under 18 looks and dresses like an ordinary child or teenager of that age and is never styled to look sexy; any other supporting role is an ordinary-looking person of that age.
The outfit is identical in every view and in the close-up: the same garments, accessories and details on the same side of the body, seen from that view's angle (an earring on the left ear stays on the left ear; a tie, a pocket square, gloves or hair ribbons are in every view or in none). Garments are plain, with no logo, brand mark, or printed letters or numbers.

Avoid: a different face between the views, an older-looking or younger-looking face than 27, doll-like face, a second outfit, extra people, extra limbs, text or labels.
